post.summary: Create a ranked map for a context.
post.description:
This endpoint:
    * Returns 200 OK with ranked map details when created successfully.
* Returns 401 Unauthorized when the guild has reached its maximum number of ranked maps.
* Returns 400 Bad Request with validation details when validation fails.
* Returns 404 Not Found when the map is not found on BeatSaver.
* Returns 429 Too Many Requests when rate limited by BeatSaver API.
* Returns 500 Internal Server Error when BeatSaver API fails.

baseMapVersion.description: The map version that will be used as the base for the ranked map.

manualRating.description:
Used to force a specific difficulty and/or accuracy star rating for the map.
If null, the star ratings will be calculated automatically by BeatLeader's ExMachina.

categoryIds.description: The categories to assign the ranked map to.

levelIds.description: The levels to assign the ranked map to (in case of RankedMapList levels).

EOrder.description: Represents the order in which values will be sorted.

difficultyStar.description: When specified, the difficulty rating of the map won't be calculated by BeatLeader's ExMachina.

accuracyStar.description: When specified, the accuracy rating of the map won't be calculated by BeatLeader's ExMachina.
